Grade: PP2
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: FUN
Topic 12.1: Modern/ GAMES fun games.

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Modern/ GAMES fun games.. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. perform fun games for enjoyment
2. appreciate and acknowledge each other as they perform the fun games Core-Competence

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. perform fun games for enjoyment
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to perform fun games for enjoyment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. appreciate and acknowledge each other as they perform the fun games Core-Competence
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate and acknowledge each other as they perform the fun games Core-Competence. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”
